def test_wrap_text_preserve_paragraphs_collapses_continuation_indent():
    """Continuation lines of a paragraph are indented in the docstring;
    their leading whitespace must not leak into the joined text, while
    ``\\b`` blocks are kept verbatim.
    """
    text = (
        "Copies every file that changed\n"
        "    since the last run.\n"
        "\n"
        "\b\n"
        "  keep   this\n"
        "    as is"
    )
    result = click.formatting.wrap_text(text, width=78, preserve_paragraphs=True)
    assert result == "Copies every file that changed since the last run.\n\n  keep   this\n    as is"
EOF
